commits: b8775a8 Keep next/prev turning the right way when pages are a few pixels wide
summary: Inside the existing flipNext/flipPrev wrapper, page-flip's private getDirectionByPoint is temporarily replaced to return the requested direction (0 forward for flipNext, 1 back for flipPrev) and restored in finally, together with disableFlipByClick. The turn keeps its animation and goes through page-flip's normal flip event, so hash/indicator/localStorage update as before. The fix is not pure logic (it pins a library method), so nothing was added to book.ts and there is no new vitest case.

Single page 30x300 (page 14px wide): 45,44,43,44,45. Single page 20x300 (page 4px wide): 45,44,43,44,45. Single page 40x300 (page 24px wide): 45,46,47, prev->48, ArrowLeft->49 (prev went forward because flipPrev's x=10 ignores the book's left offset). not_run_with_reasons: Swipe gestures were not driven in the browser. They go through the same wrapped flipNext/flipPrev, so the fix covers them, but they are not separately verified.
Turning-direction checks at the first and last page edges in tiny sizes were not run. checkDirection still guards them, as before.
open_issues: The wrapper depends on page-flip 2.0.x's private getDirectionByPoint and on the FlipDirection const-enum values (0 forward, 1 back). The existing 'ponytail: re-check on upgrade' comment covers this.
